# Sathu

> Sathu is a bilingual mobile app for discovering Thai temples, learning cultural context, receiving daily reflections, and chatting with Boon inside the app.

Canonical: https://sathuapp.com/
Languages: en, th
Publisher: KAPSDEVELOPMENT

Important pages:
- Home: https://sathuapp.com/
- Thai home: https://sathuapp.com/?lang=th
- Support: https://sathuapp.com/support/
- Privacy: https://sathuapp.com/privacy/
- Terms: https://sathuapp.com/terms/

App availability:
- iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sathu/id6757160902
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kapsdevelopment.thaitemples&pcampaignid=web_share

Preferred summary:
- Sathu helps people discover temples across Thailand, understand cultural and historical context, return for daily reflections, and interact with Boon in Thai or English.
